actual_controller_chain.final_submit: sole original NativeActionBridge registry path; helper/SDK layer has no extra submit
actual_controller_chain.only_payload_source_amendment: unique common_io.py role=script binding becomes role=single in generated payload copy
actual_controller_chain.protocol_mode_unchanged: public_b0 / public_result_v1; outer comparison arm is B1 separately
actual_controller_chain.result_source: only /logs/b0-agent-result.json generated by original controller/entry; never host-private evaluator directories
actual_controller_chain.source_binding: every actual derived payload source path and digest recorded; no invisible PYTHONPATH shadow module

identity.derivation: full- + SHA256(canonical UTF-8 JSON of identity_binding); canonical sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),ensure_ascii=True,allow_nan=False

ownership.root: source binding, candidate metadata, release and workflow

poll_request.request_id: same original start request_id; polling does not reserve or bind an absent request

real_ipc_test_gate.local_capability_denied: only an actual AF_UNIX PermissionError may skip when flag is absent
real_ipc_test_gate.qualification_scope: controlled subprocess owner/SDK IPC only; no model, original task, business recovery, AIOS qualification or cleanup certification
real_ipc_test_gate.required_mode: AF_UNIX unavailability must fail; real socket tests remain enabled

request_rules.different_request_id_after_any_launch_re: return original helper record with disposition=already_reserved_other_request; no new reservation and no second launch
request_rules.parameters_for_full_macro: exactly empty JSON object; policy and capabilities are host/source bound
request_rules.poll_by_request_id: response identifies original_request_id and request_binding; ready/not_registered remains read-only; mismatch never triggers start
request_rules.same_request_id_same_payload: return original helper record without launching again

session.controller_reported_status: null or bounded public controller status; not an original evaluator score
session.controller_result_handle: null or relative approved result path, raw sha256, bytes and immutable evidence binding
session.helper_model_calls_scope: deterministic helper only; outer B1 model accounting is separate
session.process: observed PID/starttime/boot identity and returncode, or null

start_request.parent_model_request_id: null or 32 lowercase hex characters; caller attribution claim, not verified model provenance
start_request.request_id: 32 lowercase hex characters, fixed for this requested helper start

state_and_lifecycle.OS_exit: only records process exit; missing/invalid controller result is unknown; exit 0 is never business success
state_and_lifecycle.after_spawn: retain stdout/stderr and PID + /proc starttime + boot_id; exec actual original agent_entry preserves child PID
state_and_lifecycle.before_spawn: persist launch_reserved and immutable original request binding before Popen; at most one reservation
state_and_lifecycle.client_disconnect: does not cancel, kill, mark business success, or authorize another start
state_and_lifecycle.one_owner: fcntl flock lifetime lock per session, plus SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE and full durable commit
state_and_lifecycle.owner_restart: ready may remain ready; every reserved/running job becomes unknown and is never respawned, even if no PID was saved
state_and_lifecycle.poll: read same session/result handles only; never instantiate Controller/Driver, call native transport, refresh budget or reset incident clock
state_and_lifecycle.spawn_exception_or_incomplete_identity: unknown, keep reservation and evidence, no retry

testing_boundary: local controlled subprocess + real SQLite + actual frozen-source overlay validation only; never run original business recovery or paid/model/remote endpoints

transport.client_timeout_semantics: client closes its socket only; it never signals owner/helper and never automatically resends start
transport.framing: one UTF-8 JSON object followed by LF per connection; one reply JSON object followed by LF
